items.title: If you are building AI agents with domain-specific Small Language Models (SLMs), you have likely hit a familiar wall: their tool-calling
items.summary: If you are building AI agents with domain-specific Small Language Models (SLMs), you have likely hit a familiar wall: their tool-calling performance drops significantly when exposed to a large catalog of functions, which is often the case in enterprise context. The common industry advice is to fine-tune your model or upgrade to an expensive 70B alternative. But there is a much simpler, cheaper solution. Instead of changing the model, change what it sees. With DSTA, it will develop ways to run and secure the technology across different systems. Red Hat has opened an Asia-Paciﬁc AI Centre of Excellence CoE in Singapore to help regional customers put AI projects into use. At the CoE, Red Hat engineers will develop software designs for problems that recur across different customers' projects. They will also contribute code to open-source projects used to deploy and manage AI, and may integrate technology from other companies when a project requires it.
